create_pipeline_inpaint: create a KolorsControlNetInpaintPipeline for inpainting images with ControlNet guidance
run_pipeline_inference: run the pipeline to generate inpainted images from a prompt, image, mask, and control image
encode_prompt_text: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using the ChatGLM text encoder
prepare_mask_latents: prepare mask and masked image latents for concatenation with denoising latents
prepare_control_image: preprocess and resize ControlNet conditioning images for the denoising loop
